description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Vilis and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Activate Temple Bell by tapping it, causing each player to draw a card.
Underworld Dreams triggers for each opponent.
Resolve the first Underworld Dreams trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
The opponent's Vilis triggers, causing them to draw a card.
Underworld Dreams triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Repeat steps 5-6 until that opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining opponent.
